-No repost or post of edits without my permission!-
​
I make icons since XP was around, so my icons cover various styles from XP over VX Ace to MV and MZ. Take your time and have a look around, you will very likely find something for your game as well!
Be sure to read the rules - and leave a like and feedback of you found anything useful!
Spoiler
The first thing to mention is that I set great store on how you ask me to help you. I am a human being and not an icon machine.
Please read both - dos and don'ts.
There are two styles I mainly support:
Ace
(24*24):
Not more than
2
at one time.
MV Icons (own style, no RTP!)
(32*32)
Not more than
2
at one time!
MV Icons II (manually(!) upscaled Ace Style)
(32*32)
1
from scratch or up to
2
upscales from my 24*24 icons
Big Icons
(48*48):
You can ask for
1
from scratch icon or
2
resizes of existing (in my sheet or the RTP) icons at one time.
(If you want another size, ask me)
Do:
What do you need? -
Good description and pictures!
If there is no chance to find an image a good description is okay, but a image and just the title isn't!
Be patient and friendly and I'll treat you the same way.
Give that Avy some
feedback
after she did your request.
Please check the sheet before requesting something.
Don'ts:
No "grocery lists". Write a proper request text!
I
won't do recolor
requests!
If I refuse your request, deal with it
and wait more than just a few days before coming back again.
If there are already
a lot of open requests, wait
until they are solved.
If you have more general requests, here ist
Granny's Icon List.
Check it before you request thigs like "more keys" or "an iron sword". There are already enough of those general things.
Spoiler

posts.body:
Oh hey.  Sweet.
As long as you're offering -
What do you need? - A set of five magic wands and five athame (magician's swords), meant to be VX Ace equipment slot icons.
The first wand is stick of peeled rowan with an amythest lashed to the end of it with cord, the Apprentice Wand.
The second is a copper rod with scrimshaw carved into it, the Blasting Rod (yes, it's a reference to a certain Chicagoan's Blasting Rod).
The third wand is a slender silver rod topped with a silver crescent moon, the Moonlight Wand.
The fourth wand is a rod of gold, tipped with a ruby: the Phoenix Wand.
The final wand is a length of lavender
unicorn horn
with it's end carved into a handle, the Alicorn Mae'ghan.
As for the Athame:
The first is an ordinary double-edged shortsword, the Witchblade.
The second is inlaid with golden runes, the Rune Edge.
The third is a
Kris knife
with a flower motif, the Flower Shield.
The fourth is silver and emerald with an (eastern) draconic motif for the hilt, the Dragon Sword.
The fifth is
a lot like this thing
, if that thing was carved from a single piece of crystal; the Starlight Sword.
Thank you so much!  If I use this in a commercial game, you will be getting a free copy as per your TOS.
